newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ unveils Southern Hemisphere's tallest tower.
newsitem.headline: NZ unveils Southern Hemisphere's tallest tower.

text.p: Tens of thousands of people braved cold, blustery weather to watch a fireworks and laser display celebrating the opening of New Zealand's Sky Tower on Sunday.

Much of Auckland was locked in traffic jams as spectators rushed to the best vantage points to see the tower, which stands 328 metres (yards) tall, light up like a roman candle and the harbour erupt to the effects of 44 tonnes of pyrotechnics.
The Sky Tower, said to be the tallest building in the Southern Hemisphere, forms part of the Sky City casino complex, which was officially opened last year.
